overlapTerms: ## Conversational Texture The operator directed reconciling the earlier duplicate implementation onto main's infrastructure rather than shipping two incompatible experiment-arm systems, and to keep only the genuinely net-new value (the JSON-leak closure). This story is that net-new isolation layer; the render gate, arm resolver, and retrieval block themselves remain B-ab8d's.

## Solution Tradeoffs Option A (chosen): a thin isolation layer keyed on the SAME resolveExperimentArm — redactMemoryPackForControlArm empties the pack at each JSON surface, final_response_check joins surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack, experienceRefs() returns [] on control, and two corpus tools join the memoryRetrieval markers. Option B (rejected): rewrite B-ab8d to not keep the JSON pack — larger blast radius, breaks its measurement-shape contract. Option C (rejected): block every serialized command on control — over-broad, kills legitimate treatment/no-experiment output.

Add a control-arm isolation layer on top of main's B-ab8d experiment-arm render gate: redact the runtime memory pack at every JSON/file serialization surface the render gate leaves host-readable (done_closure/final_response_check/host_dispatch/handoff/manifest/health), gate final_response_check (the 8th RuntimeConsumer) through surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack, gate parallel_dispatch experience injection, and add two corpus-export commands to the memoryRetrieval block. Keyed on main's resolveExperimentArm (LATTICE_* env). Measurement stays lossless via the experience_pack_surfaced event; treatment and no-experiment output byte-identical.
Control-arm memory JSON-leak isolation on top of B-ab8d experiment-arm gate
